team.collaboration: Three contestants collaborate on one shared programming workstation for a Codeforces problem proxied through VJudge.

human_constraints: Compete as three co-located teammates on one shared workstation for this Codeforces problem.
Only one contestant at a time may edit, execute local tests, or submit a run.
Do not use the public Internet, external LLMs, search engines, or outside help.
Submit a complete stdin/stdout program; only an Accepted remote/local judge result solves the problem.
After a rejected run, diagnose before thrashing the same approach.
rules_text: You are one of three teammates sharing one workstation on a Codeforces problem (VJudge-proxied). Allowed languages include C++ and Python 3 with stdin/stdout. Internet, external LLMs, and outside help are forbidden. Prefer evidence-backed debugging after WA/TLE/RE/CE.

adaptations: Team size is a simulation choice for collaboration schemas; Codeforces problems are normally individual.
Remote judging uses an experimental local VJudge gateway when configured.

deliverable.answer_format: Submit a complete stdin/stdout program through submit_code / submit_final.
